source_rules.standalone_macd: long/cash simple moving-average crossover; README discusses 12/26 and 10/21
source_rules.comparison_macd: long/cash pandas adjust-true EWM crossover with spans 5 and 34
source_rules.awesome_zero_line: SMA5 minus SMA34 of (high+low)/2; long when positive and cash when negative
source_rules.awesome_saucer: two source transition conditions are assigned before the zero-line comparison

defects_and_ambiguities: The Awesome zero-line branch overwrites the saucer assignment on every loop iteration, making the saucer ineffective in the executed source.
The saucer comments, candle colors, oscillator directions, and assigned signs are internally confusing; a repaired overlay cannot be treated as source-faithful primary evidence.
Repeated chained indexing and cumulative-sum mutation make state behavior fragile.
The fixed 100-share, 5000-capital accounting is price-scale dependent and can imply uncontrolled leverage.
The displayed Sharpe is total return divided by daily standard deviation, not annualized mean excess return divided by volatility.
Same-row signal and portfolio operations do not provide a sufficiently explicit next-period execution audit.
The source tests one historical security and reports an informal comparison without statistical uncertainty or realistic portfolio-level controls.
independent_treatment: Test the effective zero-line Awesome rule and EWM5/34 MACD as fixed primary rules. Keep SMA10/21 and a repaired saucer overlay diagnostic-only. Replace source accounting and timing independently.
